html:
The Wadjigu, also known as the Wadja, were an Aboriginal Australian people of inland eastern Queensland, in the Dawson River country.

Little is recorded about them. Their neighbours were the Gangulu, Garingbal, Yiman and Wuli Wuli. Squatters moved stock into the Dawson valley in the 1850s, and the frontier there was among the most violent in the colony of Queensland.
sum: The Wadjigu, also known as the Wadja, were an Aboriginal Australian people of inland eastern Queensland, in the Dawson River country.
